metadata.title: Solitons on Statistical Manifolds and Their Submanifolds
metadata.abstract:
Statistical manifolds, introduced by Amari in information geometry, carry a pair of dual torsion-free connections $(
abla,
abla^{*})$ together with a Riemannian metric. In this chapter we survey the theory of \emph{statistical solitons}, that is, vector fields and constants that solve the Ricci-soliton equation simultaneously for $
abla$ and $
abla^{*}$, together with the statistical analogue of almost quasi-Yamabe solitons. We discuss two principal settings: (i) statistical warped products $\R	imes_f N_2$ and $N_1	imes_f\R$ for (pseudo) Riemannian manifolds $N_{1}$ and $N_{2}$, where the soliton equation constrains the warping function; and (ii) statistical submanifolds of Kenmotsu statistical manifolds, where the position of the Reeb field $\xi$ relative to the submanifold and the presence of concircular or concurrent vector fields determine the Einstein, $\eta$-Einstein or quasi-Einstein character of the submanifold. We further review the results of Blaga and Chen on gradient solitons and statistical structures, in particular the connections $
abla^{	heta}$ defined by a $1$-form, volume formulas and bounds for the Ricci tensor. We also describe Chen-type inequalities for statistical warped product submanifolds, which give the extrinsic context in which such solitons live. Key steps of the proofs, remarks on the sharpness of hypotheses, worked examples, and open problems are included.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 本文综述统计流形上同时针对一对对偶无挠联络满足Ricci孤立子方程的结构，以及统计almost quasi-Yamabe孤立子。讨论统计翘曲积中翘曲函数的限制，Kenmotsu统计子流形中Reeb场位置及concircular/concurrent向量场如何决定Einstein、η-Einstein或quasi-Einstein性质。
techniques: 对偶联络的统计孤立子方程
梯度孤立子、体积及Chen型不等式
analysis.breakthrough: 将不同统计几何孤立子设置及相关子流形不等式组织成综述，包含证明要点、假设尖锐性讨论、例子和开放问题。
analysis.limitations: 这是综述章节，不宜把回顾的已知结果统一标成本文新定理。统计联络的孤立子与普通Levi-Civita Ricci流孤立子概念不同，不能直接转用其流解释。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
